verdict.rationale: Railway documents instant rollback to any previous version, per-PR preview environments for review before merge, and a Railway Agent that opens pull requests so AI-made changes can be reviewed and merged. Optional YAML config suggests settings can be versioned in the repo. All of this applies to deployments and code, not to a distinct automation construct. missing for 10: an explicit automation/workflow object with its own version history, review and rollback of agent-initiated platform changes (not just code PRs), documented config-as-code versioning detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
